subject: Greenline onboarding — procurement portal provisioning issue and manual fallback
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@greenline.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Greenline onboarding kickoff — procurement portal provisioning issue and next steps

Hi Sophie,

Great to meet you (virtually) — excited to get Greenline set up so we can start routing POs. A quick summary of where we are and two asks to unblock the first order:

Context: Finance told me you attempted to register in our Coupa tenant but the account did not finish provisioning (error referenced affiliation/org claim). We have a PO scheduled to go live on 2026-08-20 and want to avoid delaying payment.

Immediate requests:
- Can you confirm exactly what error you saw (screenshot helps) and whether your team tried SSO or the email invite flow?
- Please send over a completed W-9, remit-to and banking instructions, and a sample PO you expect to receive (sample PO number and PDF). If you already have those, reply with attachments to this thread.

Operational notes:
- We use Coupa for POs; our standard remit field is "RemitToAccountId" (6-digit). If your finance team requires specific PO metadata (cost-center, project code), let us know and we’ll add routing rules.
- If Coupa provisioning is blocked for >48 hours, we can manually create a vendor record and route the PO to your email/billing mailbox as a fallback while we resolve portal access. That manual provisioning will require the W-9 + bank ACH info.

Can you get the requested docs over by end of day tomorrow (2026-08-04)? I’ll coordinate manual provisioning if we don’t have a successful register by then.

Thanks — copying Marcus to handle the manual provisioning side and Laura for billing questions.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (attached internally)
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@greenline.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Blake <aaron.blake@greenline.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 11:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Greenline onboarding kickoff — procurement portal provisioning issue and next steps

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the clear note — apologies for the delay. We attempted the Coupa registration yesterday via the invite sent to procure@greenline.com. When we completed the form the portal returned an error: \"Organization claim not found / affiliation mismatch\" (screenshot attached). We did not attempt SSO; we're on the invite flow.

I've attached:
- Greenline_W9.pdf (signed)
- Greenline_PO_Template.docx (sample PO fields we publish to vendors)
- Greenline_Coupa_Screen.png (screenshot of the error)

A few quick clarifications from our side:
- Our billing team is reachable at procure@greenline.com; Aaron Blake (cc'd) handles remittance.
- We do not use SSO for vendor portals today — everything is invite/email-based.
- Bank details for ACH are sensitive; we'll provide them via secure upload if you confirm the manual provisioning path.

If manual provisioning is required, can you confirm whether Redwood needs anything in addition to the W-9 and ACH details (e.g., vendor legal entity docs, certificate of insurance)? We can provide the legal docs but would prefer to keep that for the final stage.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Lane
Vendor Relations Lead
Greenline Energy

Subject: Re: Greenline onboarding kickoff — procurement portal provisioning issue and next steps

Hi Sophie / Tessa,

Thanks — Sophie, the attachments you sent look good and are exactly what we need to start manual provisioning.

Planned actions (I will own the vendor admin steps):
1) Manual vendor record creation in Coupa (Vendor No. assigned internally) — I'll add remit-to per the W-9 and flag the account as \"Manual provision / pending claim resolution\". Estimated completion: EOD 2026-08-06.
2) Temporary PO routing: we can send the PO to procure@greenline.com and copy Aaron; once the vendor is fully provisioned we will toggle live routing.
3) Parallel diagnostics: our portal team will run an org-claim lookup to see why the invite flow failed (likely mismatch between email domain and expected legal entity). I’ll follow up with the backend trace and any required changes.

Requests for Greenline:
- Please provide the ACH details via our secure upload link (I’ll send a separate DocuSign/SecureUpload link by EOD).
- Confirm whether Greenline wants \"Net 30\" or another payment term (we default to Net 30).

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- 2026-08-05: Marcus to create manual vendor record and confirm PO routing.
- 2026-08-06: Greenline to return ACH via secure upload and confirm payment terms.
- 2026-08-07: Portal diagnostics complete and decision on keeping vendor on manual route or resolving claim.

If that timeline works I’ll proceed. I’m also linking the HubSpot deal so our CS and Finance teams can track: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9302

Laura — could you confirm whether we need COI/legal docs before we switch to live routing?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Partner Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
